191: Those whose quarrels and troubles of mind the Guru's word has removed,
their round of birth and death has ended and they have found every comfort. ॥1॥
Those who have dwelt on the fearless Lord have lost all their fears.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Singing God's praises in the company of the holy, one becomes fearless. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Those who have lodged God's lovely feet within their hearts,
the Guru has carried across the ocean of the fire of craving. ॥2॥
Those drowning in the ocean of vices the perfect Guru pulled out,
and joined them again to God, from whom they had been broken off for many births. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: I am a sacrifice to that Guru,
meeting whom our spiritual state is raised high. ॥4॥56॥125॥
In the company of the holy, take the shelter of that God.
Hand over your mind and body, every sense, to Him. ॥1॥
O my brother, drink the water of God's Name that gives spiritual life.
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ; ਸਭ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whoever has remembered it, remembering again and again, has quenched all the burning of the vices. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Cast out pride and end the round of birth and death.
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਨਮਸਕਾਰਹੁ ॥੨॥
Lay your head at the feet of God's servant. ॥2॥
With every breath keep God cherished in your mind.
ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ; ਜੋ ਚਾਲੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੩॥
Gather that wealth of the Name which goes along with you. ॥3॥
It is gained only by the one on whose forehead good fortune has woken.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੪॥੫੭॥੧੨੬॥
Says Nanak: fall at the feet of that person. ॥4॥57॥126॥
In an instant the Guru makes green those dried up and empty of spiritual life.
Watering them with the Name, by his life-giving glance he gives them spiritual life. ॥1॥
The perfect Guru cut away all the hardships
ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੀ; ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
of the servant to whom God gave His own service and worship. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਚਿੰਤ; ਪੁਨੀ ਮਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
His every care is gone and every hope of his mind fulfilled,
the one on whom the true Guru, treasure of virtues, showed mercy. ॥2॥
His pains have fled and every comfort has come to dwell within him.
ਢੀਲ ਨ ਪਰੀ; ਜਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
When the Guru gave the order of grace for him, there was no delay at all. ॥3॥
Those who met the perfect Guru had every wish fulfilled;
O Nanak, they bore the lovely fruit of high spiritual virtues. ॥4॥58॥127॥
Their fevers and troubles are gone; God has spread peace within them.
Those to whom God gives the gift of His Name become cool at heart. ॥1॥
By God's grace their life becomes easy,
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ; ਬਿਛੁਰੇ ਮੇਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and God joins to Himself those parted from Him for many births. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Remembering and remembering the Name of God,
the very trace of every disease is wiped out within them. ॥2॥
Steady in stillness and absorbed in love, he keeps uttering the words of God's praise.
O person, you too remember God all eight watches. ॥3॥
ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਜਮੁ; ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
No pain or ache comes near him, and the dread of death does not touch him,
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੫੯॥੧੨੮॥
says Nanak, the one who keeps singing God's praises. ॥4॥59॥128॥
Fine are those days and joyful those occasions of meeting,
when the Lord, untouched by Maya, is met. ॥1॥
ਓਹ ਬੇਲਾ ਕਉ; ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice to that moment
ਜਿਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ; ਜਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
in which my mind repeats God's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Fortunate is that hour for a person, and blessed that moment,
when his tongue utters God's Name. ॥2॥
Fortunate is the forehead that bows at the feet of the Guru, the saint.
Pure become the feet that walk on the path to God. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: my great good fortune wakes
when I touch the Guru's feet. ॥4॥60॥129॥
192: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਰਾਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Keep the Guru's word lodged in your mind.
Remember the Name, and all your cares will go. ॥1॥
Apart from the Lord, beings have no other support.
He alone kills, and He alone sustains. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Lodge the Guru's feet within your heart.
Repeating the Name, you will cross the ocean of the fire of craving. ॥2॥
Fix your attention on the Guru's word, which is the Guru's own form,
and you will win honour here and hereafter. ॥3॥
The one who leaves every other support and comes to the Guru's shelter,
O Nanak, his cares come to an end and he enjoys spiritual bliss. ॥4॥61॥130॥
Repeat the words of the Lord, by whose remembrance every pain goes,
and the priceless Name comes to dwell in the mind. ॥1॥
ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
O my mind, recite the words of the Lord's praise.
ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ; ਰਾਮੁ ਰਸਨ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through them the saints sing God's virtues with their tongues. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Keep praising Him, the One beside whom there is no equal,
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
by whose glance of grace lasting spiritual bliss is found. ॥2॥
Make that One Lord your friend, companion and helper,
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਖਰ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥੩॥
and engrave the letters of the Lord's praise within your mind. ॥3॥
The Master of all the world pervades every place,
and knows every heart; Nanak too sings the praises of that inner knower. ॥4॥62॥131॥
The whole world stays pressed under some fear or dread.
ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਨਾਹੀ; ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Fear has no hold on him alone who has the Name as the support of his life. ॥1॥
O God, in Your shelter no fear can take hold,
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੋਈ ਕਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
for then one is sure that only that is done which pleases You. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In grieving and rejoicing, fear keeps coming and going for worldly people.
ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
He alone has found lasting spiritual bliss who is dear to God. ॥2॥
This world is an ocean of the fire of craving, where Maya holds great sway.
Those who have found the true Guru stay cool within, even in it. ॥3॥
God, who has the power to save, Himself saves.
Says Nanak: what can poor creatures do of themselves? ॥4॥63॥132॥
By Your grace alone can Your Name be repeated.
By Your grace alone is honour found in Your court. ॥1॥
O transcendent Lord, beings have no support apart from You.
ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By Your grace alone is lasting spiritual bliss found. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੁਮ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੇ; ਤਉ. ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
If You come to dwell in the mind, no pain can touch it.
ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ; ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੨॥
By Your grace wandering goes and fear runs away. ॥2॥
O transcendent Lord, O infinite Lord, O Master of the world,
O knower of the hearts of all beings. ॥3॥
Only by Your grace can I make this prayer to my true Guru,
that I, Nanak, may receive the Name, the capital that lasts for ever. ॥4॥64॥133॥
As empty husks without grain are of no use,
so are those mouths empty that go without the Name. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਪਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
O person, keep repeating God's Name always.
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨ; ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਗਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the Name, this body that at last becomes another's is fit to be cursed. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Without repeating the Name, no one's fortune opens on his forehead.
Without her husband, what married happiness can a wife have? ॥2॥
The one who forgets the Name and busies himself with other tastes,
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਸ; ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ਕਾਇ ॥੩॥
none of his hopes ever comes to fulfilment. ॥3॥
O God, the one to whom in Your mercy You grant the gift of Your Name,
O Nanak, he alone repeats Your Name day and night. ॥4॥65॥134॥
193: You are master of every power, and You alone are my Master.
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ; ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੧॥
Everything happens by Your prompting; You know every heart. ॥1॥
O all-pervading transcendent Lord, Your servants have Your support alone.
ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ; ਉਧਰਹਿ ਜਨ ਕੋਟਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In Your shelter millions of people are saved. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
As many beings as there are, all are created by You.
By Your grace alone do they enjoy countless comforts. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ; ਸਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
Whatever happens in the world is only what pleases You.
The one who understands Your will stays absorbed in Your eternal Name. ॥3॥
O God, in Your mercy grant the gift of Your Name,
so that Nanak may keep remembering the Name, his treasure. ॥4॥66॥135॥
By great good fortune one gets the sight of that person
ਜਾ ਕੀ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
whose devotion stays fixed on God's Name. ॥1॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
The one in whose mind God's Name stays dwelling,
ਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ; ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
no pain can touch him even in a dream. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
God places all the treasures of spiritual virtue in the heart of His servant.
ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
In such a servant's company sins and pains go away. ॥2॥
ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ; ਕਥੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
The spiritual greatness of such a servant cannot be told.
That servant becomes the very form of the transcendent Lord who pervades all. ॥3॥
O God, hear my prayer and show mercy:
ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ; ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੬੭॥੧੩੬॥
give me, Nanak, the dust of the feet of such a servant of Yours. ॥4॥67॥136॥
Remembering God, your enemy, the witch Maya, will turn away from you.
If the Name comes to dwell in your mind, every comfort will dwell there. ॥1॥
O my mind, keep remembering the Name of the One God alone.
ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੈ; ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
This Name alone will be of use to your soul and stay with it. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Day and night sing the praises of the infinite Lord,
and take the pure teaching of the perfect Guru. ॥2॥
Give up every other device and keep the support of the One God alone.
Taste the Name's nectar that gives spiritual life: this is the highest of all things. ॥3॥
They alone cross the hard ocean of the world,
O Nanak, on whom God Himself casts His glance of grace. ॥4॥68॥137॥
Those who set God's lovely feet within their hearts,
meeting the perfect true Guru, they are carried across. ॥1॥
O my brothers, keep singing the songs of the Lord's praise.
ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Meeting the Guru, remember God's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Their human body, so hard to come by, becomes accepted by God,
who have gained from the true Guru the pass of God's Name. ॥2॥
Remembering God, a person reaches the state where no failing remains.
In the company of the holy, he wipes out every fear and all wandering. ॥3॥
ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖਉ; ਤਤ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Wherever I look, I see God pervading there.
O Nanak, His servants stay in the Lord's shelter. ॥4॥69॥138॥
ਗੁਰ ਜੀ ਕੇ; ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice to the sight of the true Guru.
Calling the true Guru's name to mind, a high spiritual life springs up in me. ॥1॥
O perfect transcendent Lord, O divine Guru,
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਲਾਗਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
show mercy, so that I stay devoted to Your service. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I keep the Guru's lovely feet set in my mind and heart.
ਮਨ ਤਨ ਧਨ; ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
The Guru's feet are the support of my mind, body, wealth and life. ॥2॥
Your life will succeed and you will be accepted by God,
if you know the Guru, the transcendent Lord, to be always near. ॥3॥
The dust of the feet of the Guru, the saint, is found by great good fortune.
ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੭੦॥੧੩੯॥
O Nanak, meeting the Guru, devotion to God's feet takes hold. ॥4॥70॥139॥
194: He does evil deeds in hiding and shows the world another face,
but in God's court he is bound like a thief. ॥1॥
He alone is counted God's servant who remembers God,
ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ; ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and is sure that the One pervades water, land and sky. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Poison of the vices is within him, while with his mouth he preaches life-giving counsel.
Bound in the city of death, he suffers the blows of many vices. ॥2॥
Behind many screens he commits wicked deeds,
but in an instant they come out before the world. ॥3॥
The one who stays joined within to the eternal Name, soaked in the joy of God's love,
O Nanak, the Creator is merciful to him. ॥4॥71॥140॥
ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗੁ; ਕਦੇ ਉਤਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
The colour of God's love never fades from the mind it has dyed,
but only for the one to whom the perfect Guru gives this understanding. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ; ਸੋ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
The mind dyed in God's love is touched by no other colour of Maya;
ਲਾਲ ਰੰਗ; ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
it takes a deep red colour and becomes the form of the all-pervading Creator. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The one who sits in the company of the saints and sings God's praises,
ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰੰਗੁ; ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
his colour of love never fades or leaves. ॥2॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ; ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Without remembering God, no one has found spiritual bliss.
All the other colours of Maya's pleasures fade. ॥3॥
Those whom the Guru has dyed in God's love stay ever in bloom.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੪॥੭੨॥੧੪੧॥
Says Nanak: on them the true Guru is merciful. ॥4॥72॥141॥
Remembering the Master, the sins of His servants are destroyed,
and the comforts and joys of stillness come to dwell within them. ॥1॥
God's servants keep their trust in God's help at every moment.
ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਸਭੁ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Repeating the Name, every worry within them stays wiped out. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Living in the company of the holy, no fear or wandering can touch them,
for day and night the praises of the Sustainer are sung within them. ॥2॥
In His mercy, God, who frees from the bonds of Maya,
has given His servants the support of His lovely feet. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: in their minds trust in God's support stays firm,
and His servants ever drink the nectar of praise that makes life pure. ॥4॥73॥142॥
ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
The one whose mind becomes absorbed in God's feet,
ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
his every pain and ache is gone and his wandering is ended. ॥1॥
The one who deals in the wealth of God's Name becomes master of a steady heart,
ਜਿਸਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ; ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
for the one God favours with the gift of His Name becomes a hero against the vices. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Those on whom the Master of the earth is merciful,
ਸੇ ਜਨ ਲਾਗੇ; ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
those people fall at the Guru's feet. ॥2॥
Comfort, peace and the joys of stillness ever abide within them.
Remembering again and again the Lord of supreme bliss, people gain spiritual life. ॥3॥
The one who, staying in the company of the holy, has earned the capital of the Name,
says Nanak, God has removed his every calamity. ॥4॥74॥143॥
Remembering God, all the troubles of the mind are wiped out.
Keep God's lovely feet lodged in your mind. ॥1॥
Utter God's Name a hundred thousand times,
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਹੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O dear tongue, and keep drinking the Name's nectar of spiritual life. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Comfort, the joy of stillness and great bliss abide within those
who repeat again and again the Lord of supreme bliss, and they gain spiritual life. ॥2॥
Those who drink the Name destroy lust, anger, greed and pride within.
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਸਭ ਧੋਏ ॥੩॥
In the Guru's company they wash away all their sins. ॥3॥
O God, merciful to the meek, show mercy,
and grant Nanak the dust of the Guru's feet. ॥4॥75॥144॥
195: He whose gift a person eats and wears:
ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ; ਆਲਸੁ ਕਿਉ ਬਨੈ. ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
how can it befit anyone to be idle in remembering Him, O mother? ॥1॥
Those who forget the Master and busy themselves in other work
throw away the jewel of human life in exchange for a worthless shell. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Forsaking God and clinging to greed for other things,
and bowing to Maya, His handmaid, no one finds honour anywhere. ॥2॥
People of a dog's nature eat tasty food, fine dishes and drinks,
ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ; ਤਿਸਹਿ. ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਸੁਆਨ ॥੩॥
but these dogs do not even know Him who gave them. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: O God, we are ungrateful.
Forgive us, O God who knows all hearts. ॥4॥76॥145॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ; ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Fix your mind in meditation on God's feet.
This is the bathing at all the places of pilgrimage. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਦਿਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
O my brother, remember God all day long.
ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ; ਮਲੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whoever remembers Him has the filth of millions of births washed away. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ; ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਸਾਈ ॥
One who enshrines God's praises in his heart
obtains all the fruits his mind desires. ॥2॥
The whole life of that person, from birth to death, is accepted by God,
in whose heart the Lord comes to dwell. ॥3॥
O Nanak, those alone become people of pure life
who receive the dust of the Guru's feet. ॥4॥77॥146॥
One who goes on eating and wearing God's gifts and denies that God gave them,
ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜੋਹਹਿ; ਦੂਤ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
the messengers of the righteous judge keep their eye on him. ॥1॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਬੇਮੁਖੁ; ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
You have turned your face from Him who gave you life and body.
ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ; ਭਰਮਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਜੂਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You will wander through millions of births in many species. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Such is the way of life of one cut off from God
that whatever he does is all a turning away from Him. ॥2॥
ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ; ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
God, who gives support to a being's life, mind and body:
that very Master the one cut off from God keeps forgotten in his mind. ॥3॥
His vices grow so many that whole ledgers are written of them.
O Nanak, pray: O ocean of mercy, ocean of peace, save us. ॥4॥
O transcendent Lord, those who come to Your refuge
ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ; ਤਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੭੮॥੧੪੭॥
cut their bonds and cross over through Your Name. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥78॥147॥
Even if someone makes Him a friend for his own greed,
He fulfils all his aims and gives him the state no craving can touch. ॥1॥
Let everyone make such a friend
ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ; ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
from whose door no one goes away empty. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who has set Him in his heart even for his own ends
has had all his pains, aches and diseases taken away. ॥2॥
One whose tongue longs to utter the Lord's Name
O Nanak, say: many times over we are a sacrifice to Him;
the sight of our Gobind bears every fruit. ॥4॥79॥148॥
Millions of obstacles on their life's path are destroyed in an instant
for those who hear God's praises in the company of the holy. ॥1॥
ਪੀਵਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
Drinking the taste of God's Name and singing His life-giving virtues,
ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ; ਮਿਟੀ ਖੁਧਿ ਤਾਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and meditating on God's feet, the hunger for Maya is stilled. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He obtains all the treasures of comfort and the bliss of stillness of mind,
the one in whose heart You come to dwell, O Lord. ॥2॥
196: Beside the Name, all medicines, mantras and charms are worthless.
Keep the Creator enshrined in your heart. ॥3॥
Whoever has given up all wandering and worshipped the transcendent Lord knows this:
Says Nanak: this faith never fails to bear fruit. ॥4॥80॥149॥
Only the one on whom God has mercy meets the Guru.
ਤਿਤੁ ਬਲਿ; ਰੋਗੁ. ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
By that strength no disease can take hold. ॥1॥
By remembering God one crosses the world-ocean.
ਸਰਣਿ ਸੂਰ; ਫਾਰੇ ਜਮ ਕਾਗਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In the refuge of the valiant Guru, Death's accounts are torn up. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The one to whom the true Guru gave the mantra of God's Name
had all his aims fulfilled through this support. ॥2॥
The glory of all chanting, austerity and self-discipline came to the one
on whom the Guru was merciful and whose helper God became. ॥3॥
The one whose pride, attachment and wandering the Guru destroyed
sees the transcendent Lord pervading everywhere; behold, O Nanak. ॥4॥81॥150॥
Under the sway of sense pleasures a person grows utterly blind;
only when caught in suffering does he remember God's Name. ॥1॥
O Lord, for Your servant Your Name alone is honour.
ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨੁ; ਨਰਕਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Maya leads one drunk on her into the hell of suffering. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One beset by disease remembers the Name,
ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਤੇ ਕਾ; ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥੨॥
but of one drunk on the poison of vices no trace of spiritual life is found. ॥2॥
One whose love is fixed on God's lotus feet
does not call other comforts to mind. ॥3॥
O God, my Master, may I remember You for ever and ever.
O Nanak, pray: O Lord who knows all hearts, meet me. ॥4॥82॥151॥
The robbers, lust and the rest, keep company with a person all eight watches;
those who are saved, God Himself has saved in His mercy. ॥1॥
ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ; ਰਮਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Let everyone enjoy the taste of the Name of such a God,
ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ; ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the Lord who is master of every power. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In the world-ocean the heat of the vices burns fiercely.
God can carry one out of this burning in an instant. ॥2॥
The many snares of attachment cannot be broken by one's own effort,
but remembering the Name, people gain the fruit of release from them. ॥3॥
ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ; ਇਸ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
No clever argument or wisdom of this being can prevail against them.
O Nanak, pray: Lord, show mercy, that beings may sing Your praises. ॥4॥83॥152॥
If you have gained the purse of the wealth of God's Name,
move freely in the world's affairs, and all your tasks will be accomplished. ॥1॥
Only by great fortune can God's praises be sung.
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ; ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O transcendent Lord, only if You give this gift can we receive it. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Keep God's feet enshrined in your heart.
Boarding them as a ship, you will cross the world-ocean. ॥2॥
Let everyone keep the company of the Guru.
ਸਦਾ ਕਲਿਆਣ; ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
There is always peace there, and no pain touches again. ॥3॥
With loving devotion, worship God, the treasure of all virtues.
O Nanak, so one receives honour in God's presence. ॥4॥84॥153॥
ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ; ਪੂਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
God, the friend who pervades water, land and sky:
by always singing His virtues, every kind of wandering is ended. ॥1॥
Waking and sleeping, God is always with a person as guard,
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ; ਜਮ ਨਹੀ ਡਰੂਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
by remembering whom the fear of death does not remain. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One in whose heart God's lotus feet dwell
197: The one God's Name becomes his hope, honour, strength and wealth.
ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹ ਕੀ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਟੇਕ ॥੩॥
In his mind is the support of the eternal Banker alone. ॥3॥
The very poor and helpless, once they became the Guru's servants,
O Nanak, God saved them, giving them His hand. ॥4॥85॥154॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ; ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਚੇ ॥
Bathing in God's Name, one becomes pure in life.
ਕੋਟਿ ਗ੍ਰਹਣ; ਪੁੰਨ ਫਲ ਮੂਚੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
It brings more fruit than the merit of charity at millions of eclipses. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਰਿਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੇ ॥
One in whose heart God's feet come to dwell
has the sins of many births destroyed. ॥1॥
One who has gained the fruit of God's praises in the company of the holy
ਜਮ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ; ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
has not even seen the path of Death. ॥2॥
One who has made God the support of his mind, words and deeds
has been freed from the world and its poison. ॥3॥
The one whom God, in His mercy, has made His own,
O Nanak, ever repeats and worships God. ॥4॥86॥155॥
Take the refuge of one who has come to know God,
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ; ਚਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
for in love of God's feet mind and body grow calm. ॥1॥
ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਮਨਿ ਨ ਬਸਾਹੀ ॥
Those who do not enshrine God, destroyer of fear, in their minds
ਡਰਪਤ ਡਰਪਤ; ਜਨਮ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
pass many births trembling with fear. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ; ਬਸਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
One in whose heart God's Name dwells
ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ; ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੨॥
has all his aims and works fulfilled. ॥2॥
He in whose power lie our life, old age and death:
remember that all-powerful Lord with every breath and every morsel. ॥3॥
The one God alone is our friend, companion and helper.
O Nanak, the Master's Name is our support. ॥4॥87॥156॥
While dealing with the world outside, the saints keep God cherished in their hearts,
and in the home of the heart they keep Gobind always with them. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
God's Name always dwells in the hearts of the saints.
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ; ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Their mind and body stay dyed in God's love. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
By the Guru's grace they cross the world-ocean
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ; ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਹਿਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
and remove all the sins of many births. ॥2॥
One who enshrines the Guru's teaching becomes fortunate and honoured, his attention joined to the Name.
You too, enshrine the pure teaching of the perfect Guru. ॥3॥
Keep repeating God's lotus feet in your heart.
Nanak gains spiritual life by beholding His glory. ॥4॥88॥157॥
ਧੰਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਥਾਨੁ; ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
Singing Gobind's virtues, this place, the heart, becomes fortunate,
ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਬਸਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
for God Himself has settled all comfort and joy there. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਿਪਤਿ ਤਹਾ; ਜਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Calamity dwells in the heart where God is not remembered.
ਕੋਟਿ ਅਨੰਦ; ਜਹ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Where God's virtues are sung, there are millions of joys. ॥1॥
If God is forgotten, many pains and diseases surround a person.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਵਾ; ਜਮੁ. ਲਗੈ ਨ ਨੇਰੇ ॥੨॥
But in God's service, the fear of death does not come near. ॥2॥
That heart is fortunate and stays ever steady
in which God's Name alone is repeated. ॥3॥
ਜਹ ਜਾਈਐ; ਤਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Wherever I go, I see my Master with me.
The Lord who knows all hearts has met Nanak. ॥4॥89॥158॥
The person who remembers Gobind in his heart,
learned or unlearned, attains the highest spiritual state. ॥1॥
In the company of the Guru, remember God, sustainer of the world.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ; ਝੂਠਾ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the Name, no wealth or property stays with you. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
198: He alone is handsome, sharp of mind and wise
ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
Only the one who has recognised the Master dwelling in every body has come into the world fruitfully.
Recognise your Master dwelling in every body. ॥3॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਾਗ ॥
Says Nanak: one whose full fortune awakens
keeps his mind fixed on God's feet. ॥4॥90॥159॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਸਿਉ; ਸਾਕਤ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
One cut off from God can form no bond with God's servant,
ਓਹੁ ਬਿਖਈ; ਓਸੁ. ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
for he loves sense pleasures, and the servant is dyed in God's love. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
It is like a decked-out mare for an unskilled rider,
like a eunuch making love to a woman. ॥1॥
It is like someone tethering an ox's legs to milk it,
like someone riding a cow and driving it after a lion. ॥2॥
It is like someone taking a ewe and worshipping it as the wish-fulfilling cow,
like someone running off to buy goods without capital. ॥3॥
O Nanak, remember God's Name in your mind;
remember God, such a Master and friend. ॥4॥91॥160॥
That intellect is called pure and steadfast
by which one drinks the taste of God's Name, finest of all. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਰਿ ਓਟ ॥
Make God's feet the support of your heart;
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤੇ; ਹੋਵਤ ਛੋਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
so there is release from the round of birth and death. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਜਿਤੁ. ਉਪਜੈ ਨ ਪਾਪੁ ॥
That body is pure in which no sin arises.
Through the colour of God's love, the glory of one made pure shines. ॥2॥
In the company of the holy, all vices are wiped away.
This is its highest kindness of all. ॥3॥
Those who are dyed in loving devotion to God:
Nanak begs for the dust of their feet. ॥4॥92॥161॥
Those whose love for God has become such
become greatly fortunate and full of virtue, and God unites them with Himself. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
As a wife rejoices on seeing her husband,
ਤਿਉ. ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ; ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
so God's servant comes alive within, remembering the Name. ॥1॥
As a mother lives by seeing her sons,
ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ; ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
so God's devotee is woven into God like warp and weft. ॥2॥
As a greedy person rejoices on seeing wealth,
ਜਨ. ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ; ਲਾਗੋ ਮਨਾ ॥੩॥
so the devotee's mind clings to God's lotus feet. ॥3॥
O Giver, do not forget me even for a moment,
O God, support of Nanak's life. ॥4॥93॥162॥
Those absorbed in the taste of God's Name, finest of all,
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤੀ ਬੀਧੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
stay pierced with loving devotion to God's lotus feet. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
All other tastes look like ashes to them;
without the Name, the world's things seem useless. ॥1॥
God Himself draws them out of the blind well of attachment.
They see the Sustainer pervading forest, grass and the three worlds;
they see the world as God's expanse, God beside all beings and merciful. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: cherish in your heart that praise
One should bathe daily in the pool of God's Name.
ਝੋਲਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ; ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One should drink with deep love God's life-giving Name, the finest taste. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
bathing in it, all aims are fulfilled. ॥1॥
199: There one meets with God's saint,
and removes the sins of millions of births. ॥2॥
Gurmukhs who remember the Name enjoy spiritual bliss,
and see God, master of supreme bliss, present in mind and heart. ॥3॥
The one who finds the treasure of God's feet,
O Nanak, God's servants are a sacrifice to him. ॥4॥95॥164॥
ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿ; ਜਿਤੁ. ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Make such effort that no filth of vice clings to your mind,
ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਮਹਿ; ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and this mind stays awake in God's praises. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Remember the One alone; bring no love for another.
In the company of the holy, repeat only the Name. ॥1॥
Religious rites, fasts, worship and fixed observances:
count none of them a help apart from remembering the transcendent Lord. ॥2॥
That person's labour alone bears fruit
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
whose love is with his own God. ॥3॥
That Vaishnav is beyond the beyond and supreme.
Says Nanak: it is the one who has cast out his vices. ॥4॥96॥165॥
O foolish one, the things that leave a person while still alive:
who can gain anything from them at death? ॥1॥
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ॥
Remember Gobind; this alone can stay written in your mind and heart by God's law,
ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਜ; ਨ ਆਵਤ ਬਿਖਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
but Maya is of no use at all. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Whoever has eaten the cheating herb of sense pleasures
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ; ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
This world-ocean is hard to cross and full of terrible pain.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
How will you cross it without God's Name? ॥3॥
Joining the company of the holy, set right both this world and the next.
The beard that keeps flaring up at the poor,
the transcendent Lord has burnt in fire. ॥1॥
The Creator does justice without flaw.
He is able to protect His servants. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
From the beginning, from the start of the ages, God's glory has been manifest,
that the slanderer lies spiritually dead, with great anguish in him. ॥2॥
ਤਿਨਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ; ਜਿ ਰਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
God has struck him with spiritual death, and no one else can save him;
his name is ill here and hereafter. ॥3॥
God keeps His servants close to His heart.
O Nanak, take His refuge and remember God's Name. ॥4॥98॥167॥
The Creator Himself proved false the charge drawn up against us,
and the sinners were struck with anguish. ॥1॥
The one whose helper my Gobind becomes:
ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉ; ਜਮੁ. ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the fear of death cannot touch him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who tells lies to harm others, in the court of the eternal Lord
that blind fool beats his head with his hands. ॥2॥
Those who do evil deeds stay gripped by many diseases.
God Himself sits as the judge. ॥3॥
By their own deeds beings bind themselves.
ਦਰਬੁ ਗਇਆ; ਸਭੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸਾਥੈ ॥੪॥
All their wealth departs along with their life. ॥4॥
O Nanak, those who take refuge and fall at God's door:
my Creator has always kept their honour. ॥5॥99॥168॥
ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ; ਮਨ ਮੀਠ ਖਟਾਨੀ ॥
To his mind the dust of God's servant's feet tastes sweet,
ਪੂਰਬਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਧੁਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that being on whose brow destiny is written by God, by his past deeds. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
200: Because of a proud intellect, the mind stays coated with the grease of pride;
with the dust of the holy one's feet, the intellect is scoured clean. ॥1॥
If a person washes his body in the waters of many pilgrim places,
ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ; ਸੁਧੁ ਨ ਤੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
still his mind's filth does not come off, and he is not made pure that way. ॥2॥
One who meets the true Guru, ever kind to him,
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ; ਕਾਟਿਆ ਭਉ ਕਾਲ ॥੩॥
by remembering God again and again cuts away the fear of death. ॥3॥
God's Name is release from vices, food for the spiritual life and the right way to live.
O Nanak, keep singing His virtues with loving devotion. ॥4॥100॥169॥
God's servants hold a high spiritual rank;
by meeting them the soul is lit with knowledge. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ; ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਕਾਨੀ ॥
O my mind, listen attentively to God's Name.
ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O person, you will find peace at God's door. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
All eight watches one should remember the Lord who sustains the world.
O Nanak, beholding Him everywhere, the mind stays in bloom. ॥2॥101॥170॥
Coolness has come to one whom the Guru, God's own form, has given the Name;
ਤਾਪ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਸੇ; ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
his sufferings and sins are destroyed, my brother. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who always utters God's Name with his tongue,
his ailments all go, and joy upon joy abides in him. ॥1॥
One who keeps reflecting on the virtues of the unreachable Supreme Lord
is carried across in the Guru's company. ॥2॥
Keep singing His pure virtues always.
Their every ailment goes, and those people are saved, my friend. ॥3॥
ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
May I remember my Lord in mind, word and deed.
O Nanak, pray: I, Your servant, have come to Your refuge. ॥4॥102॥171॥
O divine Guru, the one whose inner eyes You have lit,
ਭਰਮ ਗਏ; ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
his wanderings are gone, and his service has borne fruit. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
O beautiful Lord, You alone have saved me from smallpox.
O Supreme Lord God, it is You who showed mercy. ॥1॥
O Nanak, one who repeats the Name gains spiritual life,
for in the company of the holy he drinks God's life-giving nectar. ॥2॥103॥172॥
ਧਨੁ ਓਹੁ ਮਸਤਕੁ; ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਨੇਤ ॥
Fortunate is that forehead, and fortunate the eyes lost in beholding You;
ਧਨੁ ਓਇ ਭਗਤ; ਜਿਨ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੇਤ ॥੧॥
fortunate are those devotees whose love for You endures. ॥1॥
Without the Name, how can peace be found?
ਰਸਨਾ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਸੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
With the tongue one should utter God's Name and praise. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One should be a sacrifice to those,
O Nanak, who have repeated the Name of God, free of craving. ॥2॥104॥173॥
O God, You are my counsellor, and You dwell with me.
You protect all, caring for them and watching over them. ॥1॥
Such is God, a companion in this world and the next,
ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ; ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that He keeps His servant's honour, my brother. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਆਗੈ ਆਪਿ; ਇਹੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
He is our keeper in the next world too, He in whose power this world lies.
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਉ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
All eight watches my mind repeats God's Name. ॥2॥
He receives honour, is accepted, and gets Your eternal Name as his pass,
the one for whom You Yourself give the command. ॥3॥
He Himself is the giver, He Himself the sustainer.
ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਨਕ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੪॥੧੦੫॥੧੭੪॥
O Nanak, keep God's Name treasured in your heart always. ॥4॥105॥174॥
One on whom the infallible Guru is kind,
in his heart the Lord who sustains the world always dwells. ॥1॥
ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਤ; ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Remembering God, he has always enjoyed spiritual bliss,
